next.reason: §1985:XIII.3.8.3 SR8 confines RH/PH to HEADING..FIRST DETAIL-1 (RH on its own page: HEADING..page limit), CH and DE to FIRST DETAIL..LAST DETAIL, CF to FIRST DETAIL..FOOTING, PF and RF to FOOTING+1..page limit. 2023 states the same regions: 'each report group shall be confined within one or more of these regions' (§2023:13.18.39.4 GR1), the region integers (§2023:13.18.39.4 GR2), RH/RF on a page by itself (§2023:13.18.39.4 GR4), the upper and lower limits per type (§2023:13.18.57.4 GR7, GR8), and the compile-time check of absolute lines (§2023:13.18.35.3 SR6 c). The 2023 control heading bound is the LAST CONTROL HEADING integer, but a 1985 program has no such phrase and 'integer-5 will be equal to integer-6, if LAST DETAIL is specified' (§2023:13.18.39.4 GR3 c), reproducing the 1985 LAST DETAIL bound; LAST CONTROL HEADING and OR PAGE are 2023-only syntax.
